DeepSeek Harness 原生交互式 Git diff 审查，支持结构化批注并回传当前 Agent 会话。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-revdiff"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"=24">"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Native interactive diff review for DeepSeek Harness. The plugin reads a Git unified diff, parses it "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"into files, hunks, and line locations, presents its own terminal review interface, and queues submit"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ted annotations as the Agent's next durable follow-up turn."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why this exists 💡"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Reviewing a diff in a separate tool breaks the connection between the change, the review context, an"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"d the Agent that will act on the feedback. `dsh-revdiff` keeps review inside Harness, so annotations"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" are created against the actual Git diff and returned to the same durable session."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features ✨"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- Review tracked working-tree, staged, unstaged, or base-revision changes with optional path filters"},{"id":"p9s2","text":".
- Navigate between files, hunks, and diff lines from an interactive terminal.
- Add, edit, and del"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ete issue, suggestion, question, or praise annotations.
- Submit structured annotations to the curre"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"nt Agent through `agent.followup()` with message provenance.
- Configure Git execution, diff context"},{"id":"p9s5","text":", size and time limits, terminal grace period, and comment length."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install 📦"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Add this checkout to a Harness profile:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The only external runtime requirement is Git in the same execution world as Harness."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Use 🚀"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The default reviews all tracked working-tree changes against `HEAD`, including staged and unstaged c"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"hanges. `--staged` reviews the index, `--unstaged` reviews only worktree changes relative to the ind"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ex, and a base revision reviews the working tree against that revision. Put path filters after `--`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The Harness process must own an interactive terminal. The review interface supports:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- `↑`/`↓` or `k`/`j`: move between diff lines
- `n`/`p`: move between hunks
- `]`/`[` or `→`/`←`: mo"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ve between files
- `a`: add an issue, suggestion, question, or praise annotation
- `e`: edit the sel"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ected line's annotation
- `d`: delete the selected line's annotation
- `s`: submit annotations to th"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"e current Agent
- `q`, Escape, or Ctrl-C: cancel without sending a message"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Annotations retain the file, old/new side, line number, selected code, kind, and comment. They are s"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ent through `agent.followup()` with `dsh-revdiff` message provenance, so the review enters the same "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"Harness session rather than an external side channel."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Configure ⚙️"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Override the inserted row in a later Harness patch layer:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Develop 🧑‍💻"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Commit the generated `lib/` files with source changes so Git installs include the declared package e"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ntry before build scripts run."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Scope 🎯"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Version 0.1 reviews textual changes already represented by `git diff`. Untracked files, binary patch"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"es, side-by-side rendering, mouse input, and a browser-hosted review surface are not included yet. T"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"he review engine and annotation model are owned by this project so those capabilities can evolve for"},{"id":"p27s4","text":" Harness without following another review tool's interface."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## License 📄"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"MIT"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Credits 🙏"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The product idea is informed by `pi-diff-review` and `revdiff`, but this is an independent implement"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ation built specifically around Harness commands, managed subprocesses, Agent lifecycle, and message"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" provenance.
